title: Granola wordmark
description: A heavy, tightly tracked lowercase wordmark in the body face with an optional small mark. Inline for headers; fill mode stretches the name across the full width of its container, like a giant footer logo.
notes: fill mode is an SVG <text> with textLength, so it scales with its container and never overflows
name: granola-wordmark

props.name: name
props.description: the company name, set in type (no logo)

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the name (e.g. a lucide icon); inline mode only

props.name: href
props.description: where it links; without it the wordmark is plain text

props.name: mode
props.description: inline: header size · fill: stretched to the full width of its container (footer)
